pli-tv-kd22:1.1.1: tena kho pana samayena vassasataparinibbute bhagavati vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū vesāliyaṃ dasa vatthūni dīpenti
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.2: kappati siṅgiloṇakappo kappati dvaṅgulakappo kappati gāmantarakappo kappati āvāsakappo kappati anumatikappo kappati āciṇṇakappo kappati amathitakappo kappati jalogiṃ pātuṃ kappati adasakaṃ nisīdanaṃ kappati jātarūparajatanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vajjīsu cārikañcaramāno yena vesālī tadavasari.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.4: tatra sudaṃ āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.5: tena kho pana samayena vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū tadahuposathe kaṃsacāṭiṃ udakena pūretvā majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa ṭhapetvā āgatāgate vesālike upāsake evaṃ vadenti
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.6: dethāvuso saṅghassa kahāpaṇampi aḍḍhampi pādampi māsakarūpampi
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.8: evaṃ vutte āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vesālike upāsake etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.9: mā āvuso adattha saṅghassa kahāpaṇampi aḍḍhampi pādampi māsakarūpampi
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.14: evampi kho vesālikā upāsakā āyasmatā yasena kākaṇḍakaputtena vuccamānā adaṃsuyeva saṅghassa kahāpaṇampi aḍḍhampi pādampi māsakarūpampi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.15: athakho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū tassā rattiyā accayena taṃ hiraññaṃ bhikkhuggena paṭivisaṃ ṭhapetvā bhājesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.16: athakho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ yasaṃ kākaṇḍakaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.17: eso te āvuso yasa hiraññassa paṭivisoti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.1.18: natthi me āvuso hiraññassa paṭiviso nāhaṃ hiraññaṃ sādiyāmīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.2: ayaṃ āvuso yaso kākaṇḍakaputto upāsake saddhe pasanne akkosati paribhāsati appasādaṃ karoti
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.3: handassa mayaṃ paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karomāti. te tassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ akaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.4: athakho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vesālike vajjiputtake bhikkhū etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.8: athakho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ sammannitvā āyasmato yasassa kākaṇḍakaputtassa anudūtaṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.9: athakho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto anudūtena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ vesāliṃ pavisitvā vesālike upāsake etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:1.2.10: ahaṃ kirāyasmante upāsake saddhe pasanne akkosāmi paribhāsāmi appasādaṃ karomi

pli-tv-kd22:1.3.2: tatra kho āvuso bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.3: cattārome bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.4: katame cattāro. abbhaṃ bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.5: mahikā bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.6: dhūmarajo bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.7: rāhu bhikkhave asurindo candimasuriyānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.8: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro candimasuriyānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.9: evameva kho bhikkhave cattārome samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.11: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā suraṃ pivanti merayaṃ pivanti surāmerayapānā appaṭiviratā
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.12: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.13: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti methunadhammā appaṭiviratā
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.14: ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.15: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanti jātarūparajatappaṭiggahaṇā appaṭiviratā
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.16: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.17: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.19: ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
pli-tv-kd22:1.3.20: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocantīti.

pli-tv-kd22:1.4.1: ekamidaṃ āvuso samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.2: tena kho pana samayena rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.6: tena kho panāvuso samayena maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinnako hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.7: athakho āvuso maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.13: asakkhi kho āvuso maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.14: athakho āvuso maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.15: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āvuso maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.16: idha bhante rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.20: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante taṃ parisaṃ etadavocaṃ
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.26: asakkhiṃ kho ahaṃ bhante taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.27: kaccāhaṃ bhante evaṃ byākaramāno vuttavādī ceva bhagavato homi na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāmi dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaromi na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.28: taggha tvaṃ gāmaṇi evaṃ byākaramāno vuttavādī ceva me hosi
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.29: na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhasi dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākarosi na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.30: na hi gāmaṇi kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.34: yassa kho gāmaṇi jātarūparajataṃ kappati pañcapi kāmaguṇā tassa kappanti
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.35: yassa pañca kāmaguṇā kappanti ekaṃsenetaṃ gāmaṇi dhāreyyāsi
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.37: apicāhaṃ gāmaṇi evaṃ vadāmi tiṇaṃ tiṇatthikena pariyesitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd22:1.4.41: na tvevāhaṃ gāmaṇi kenaci pariyāyena jātarūparajataṃ sāditabbaṃ pariyesitabbanti vadāmīti

pli-tv-kd22:1.5.1: ekamidaṃ āvuso samayaṃ bhagavā tattheva rājagahe āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ ārabbha jātarūparajataṃ paṭikkhipi sikkhāpadañca paññāpesi.

pli-tv-kd22:1.6.1: evaṃ vutte vesālikā upāsakā āyasmantaṃ yasaṃ kākaṇḍakaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ

pli-tv-kd22:1.6.4: vasatu bhante ayyo yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vesāliyaṃ
pli-tv-kd22:1.6.5: mayaṃ ayyassa yasassa kākaṇḍakaputtassa ussukkaṃ karissāma cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānanti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.6.6: athakho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto vesālike upāsake saññāpetvā anudūtena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ārāmaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.1: athakho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū anudūtaṃ bhikkhuṃ pucchiṃsu

pli-tv-kd22:1.7.4: eko va yaso kākaṇḍakaputto samaṇo sakyaputtiyo kato

pli-tv-kd22:1.7.11.1: athakho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto pāṭheyyakānañca avantidakkhiṇāpathakānañca bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pāhesi
pli-tv-kd22:1.7.16: pure adhammavādino balavanto honti dhammavādino dubbalā honti

pli-tv-kd22:1.9.8: bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo
pli-tv-kd22:1.9.9: sace mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ revataṃ pakkhaṃ labhissāma evaṃ mayaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe balavantatarā assāmāti.

pli-tv-kd22:1.10.1: athakho āyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī āyasmantaṃ yasaṃ kākaṇḍakaputtaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.2: ayaṃ āvuso āyasmā revato bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo

pli-tv-kd22:1.10.4: idāni ca panāyasmā revato antevāsiṃ sarabhāṇakaṃ bhikkhuṃ ajjhesissati
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.5: so tvaṃ tassa bhikkhuno sarabhaññapariyosāne āyasmantaṃ revataṃ upasaṅkamitvā imāni dasa vatthūni puccheyyāsīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.6: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto āyasmato sambhūtassa sāṇavāsissa paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.7: athakho āyasmā revato antevāsiṃ sarabhāṇakaṃ bhikkhuṃ ajjhesi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.8: athakho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto tassa bhikkhuno sarabhaññapariyosāne yenāyasmā revato tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ revataṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.9: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā yaso kākaṇḍakaputto āyasmantaṃ revataṃ etadavoca

pli-tv-kd22:1.10.21: kappati bhante idāni gāmantaraṃ gamissāmīti bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjitunti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.25: kappati bhante sambahulā āvāsā samānasīmā nānūposathaṃ kātunti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.29: kappati bhante vaggena saṅghena kammaṃ kātuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.34: kappati bhante idaṃ me upajjhāyena ajjhāciṇṇaṃ idaṃ me ācariyena ajjhāciṇṇanti ajjhācaritunti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.35: āciṇṇakappo kho āvuso ekacco kappati ekacco na kappatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.38: kappati bhante yaṃ taṃ khīraṃ khīrabhāvaṃ vijahitaṃ asampattaṃ dadhibhāvaṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ pātunti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.42: kappati bhante yā sā surā asutā asampattā majjabhāvaṃ sā pātunti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.48: ime bhante vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū vesāliyaṃ imāni dasa vatthūni dīpenti
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.49: handa mayaṃ bhante imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyāma
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.52: pure adhammavādino balavanto honti dhammavādino dubbalā honti
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.53: avinayavādino balavanto honti vinayavādino dubbalā hontīti.
pli-tv-kd22:1.10.54: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā revato āyasmato yasassa kākaṇḍakaputtassa paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.2: yaso kira kākaṇḍakaputto imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyitukāmo pakkhaṃ pariyesati labhati ca kira pakkhanti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.5: kaṃ nu kho mayaṃ pakkhaṃ labheyyāma yena mayaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe balavantatarā assāmāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.7: ayaṃ kho āyasmā revato bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.8: sace mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ revataṃ pakkhaṃ labheyyāma evaṃ mayaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe balavantatarā assāmāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.9: athakho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū pahūtaṃ sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ paṭiyādesuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.10: pattampi cīvarampi nisīdanampi sūcigharampi kāyabandhanampi parissāvanampi dhammakarakampi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.11: athakho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū taṃ sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ ādāya nāvāya sahajātiṃ ujjaviṃsu
pli-tv-kd22:2.1.12: nāvāya paccorohitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle bhattavissaggaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.1: athakho āyasmato sāḷhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.4: athakho āyasmato sāḷhassa dhammañca vinayañca paccavekkhantassa etadahosi
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.5: adhammavādino pācīnakā bhikkhū dhammavādino pāṭheyyakā bhikkhūti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.6: athakho aññatarā suddhāvāsakāyikā devatā āyasmato sāḷhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.7: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva suddhāvāsesu devesu antarahitā āyasmato sāḷhassa sammukhe pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.8: athakho sā devatā āyasmantaṃ sāḷhaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.9: sādhu sādhu bhante sāḷha adhammavādino pācīnakā bhikkhū dhammavādino pāṭheyyakā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.10: tenahi bhante sāḷha yathā dhammo tathā tiṭṭhāhīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.11: pubbecāhaṃ devate etarahi ca yathā dhammo tathā ṭhito
pli-tv-kd22:2.2.12: apicāhaṃ na tāva diṭṭhiṃ āvikaromi appevanāma maṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe sammanneyyāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.1: athakho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū taṃ sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ ādāya yenāyasmā revato tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ revataṃ etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.3: pattampi cīvarampi nisīdanampi sūcigharampi kāyabandhanampi parissāvanampi dhammakarakampīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.4: alaṃ āvuso paripuṇṇaṃ me ticīvaranti na icchi paṭiggahetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.5: tena kho pana samayena uttaro nāma bhikkhu vīsativasso āyasmato revatassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.6: athakho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū yenāyasmā uttaro tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ uttaraṃ etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.8: pattampi cīvarampi nisīdanampi sūcigharampi kāyabandhanampi parissāvanampi dhammakarakampīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.9: alaṃ āvuso paripuṇṇaṃ me ticīvaranti na icchi paṭiggahetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.10: manussā kho āvuso uttara bhagavato sāmaṇakaṃ parikkhāraṃ upanāmenti
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.11: sace bhagavā paṭiggaṇhāti teneva te attamanā honti
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.12: no ce bhagavā paṭiggaṇhāti āyasmato ca ānandassa upanāmenti
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.14: yathā bhagavatā paṭiggahito evameva so bhavissatīti
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.16: yathā therena paṭiggahito evameva so bhavissatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.17: athakho āyasmā uttaro vesālikehi vajjiputtakehi bhikkhūhi nippīḷiyamāno ekaṃ cīvaraṃ aggahesi
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.22: dhammavādino pācīnakā bhikkhū adhammavādino pāṭheyyakā bhikkhūti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.24: kho āyasmā uttaro vesālikānaṃ vajjiputtakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā revato tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ revataṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.27: dhammavādino pācīnakā bhikkhū adhammavādino pāṭheyyakā bhikkhūti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.28: adhamme maṃ tvaṃ bhikkhu niyojesīti thero āyasmantaṃ uttaraṃ paṇāmesi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.29: athakho vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ uttaraṃ etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.32: adhamme maṃ tvaṃ bhikkhu niyojesīti thero maṃ paṇāmesīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.3.33: nanu tvaṃ āvuso uttara vuḍḍho vīsativassosīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.1: athakho saṅgho taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vinicchinitukāmo sannipati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.4: sace mayaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ idha vūpasamessāma siyāpi mūlādāyakā bhikkhū punakkammāya ukkoṭeyyuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.5: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ yatthevimaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ samuppannaṃ saṅgho tatthevimaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyyāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.8: tena kho pana samayena sabbakāmī nāma paṭhabyā saṅghathero vīsavassasatiko upasampadāya āyasmato ānandassa saddhivihāriko vesāliyaṃ paṭivasati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.9: athakho āyasmā revato āyasmantaṃ sambhūtaṃ sāṇavāsiṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.10: ahaṃ āvuso yasmiṃ vihāre sabbakāmī thero viharati taṃ vihāraṃ upagacchāmi
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.11: so tvaṃ kālasseva āyasmantaṃ sabbakāmiṃ upasaṅkamitvā imāni dasa vatthūni puccheyyāsīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.12: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī āyasmato revatassa paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.13: athakho āyasmā revato yasmiṃ vihāre sabbakāmī thero viharati taṃ vihāraṃ upagañchi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.14: gabbhe āyasmato sabbakāmissa senāsanaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. gabbhapamukhe āyasmato revatassa.
pli-tv-kd22:2.4.19: ayaṃ bhikkhu āgantuko kilanto na nipajjatīti
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.1: athakho āyasmā sabbakāmī rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya āyasmantaṃ revataṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.2: katamena tvaṃ bhummi vihārena etarahi bahulaṃ viharasīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.3: mettāvihārena kho ahaṃ bhante etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.4: kullakavihārena kira tvaṃ bhummi etarahi bahulaṃ viharasi
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.6: pubbepi me bhante gihibhūtassa āciṇṇā mettā
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.7: tenāhaṃ etarahipi mettāvihārena bahulaṃ viharāmi apica mayā cirappattaṃ arahattaṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.8: thero pana bhante katamena vihārena etarahi bahulaṃ viharatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.9: suññatāvihārena kho ahaṃ bhummi etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.10: mahāpurisavihārena kira bhante thero etarahi bahulaṃ viharati
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.12: pubbepi me bhummi gihibhūtassa āciṇṇā suññatā
pli-tv-kd22:2.5.13: tenāhaṃ etarahipi suññatāvihārena bahulaṃ viharāmi apica mayā cirappattaṃ arahattanti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.1: ayañcarahi therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ antarākathā vippakatā. athāyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī anuppatto hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.2: athakho āyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī yenāyasmā sabbakāmī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sabbakāmiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sambhūto sāṇavāsī āyasmantaṃ sabbakāmiṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.4: ime bhante vesālikā vajjiputtakā bhikkhū vesāliyaṃ dasa vatthūni dīpenti
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.5: kappati siṅgiloṇakappo kappati dvaṅgulakappo kappati gāmantarakappo kappati āvāsakappo kappati anumatikappo kappati āciṇṇakappo kappati amathitakappo kappati jalogiṃ pātuṃ kappati adasakaṃ nisīdanaṃ kappati jātarūparajatanti
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.6: therena bhante upajjhāyassa mūle bahu dhammo ca vinayo ca pariyatto
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.7: therassa bhante dhammañca vinayañca paccavekkhantassa kathaṃ hoti
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.10: tayāpi kho āvuso upajjhāyassa mūle bahu dhammo ca vinayo ca pariyatto
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.11: tuyhaṃ pana āvuso dhammañca vinayañca paccavekkhantassa kathaṃ hoti
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.14: mayhaṃ kho bhante dhammañca vinayañca paccavekkhantassa evaṃ hoti
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.15: adhammavādino pācīnakā bhikkhū dhammavādino pāṭheyyakā bhikkhūti
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.16: apicāhaṃ na tāva diṭṭhiṃ āvikaromi appevanāma maṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe sammanneyyāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.17: mayhaṃpi kho āvuso dhammañca vinayañca paccavekkhantassa evaṃ hoti
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.18: adhammavādino pācīnakā bhikkhū dhammavādino pāṭheyyakā bhikkhūti
pli-tv-kd22:2.6.19: apicāhaṃ na tāva diṭṭhiṃ āvikaromi appevanāma maṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe sammanneyyāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.1: athakho saṅgho taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vinicchinitukāmo sannipati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.2: tasmiṃ kho pana adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anantāni ceva bhassāni jāyanti na cekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.5: amhākaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anantāni ceva bhassāni jāyanti na cekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.6: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ubbāhikāya vūpasameyya.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.7: saṅgho cattāro pācīnake bhikkhū cattāro pāṭheyyake bhikkhū uccini
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.9: āyasmantañca sabbakāmiṃ āyasmantañca sāḷhaṃ āyasmantañca ujjasobhitaṃ āyasmantañca vāsabhagāmikaṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.11: āyasmantañca revataṃ āyasmantañca sambhūtaṃ sāṇavāsiṃ āyasmantañca yasaṃ kākaṇḍakaputtaṃ āyasmantañca sumananti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.14: amhākaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anantāni ceva bhassāni jāyanti na cekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.15: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho cattāro pācīnake bhikkhū cattāro pāṭheyyake bhikkhū sammanneyya ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.18: amhākaṃ imasmiṃ adhikaraṇe vinicchiyamāne anantāni ceva bhassāni jāyanti na cekassa bhāsitassa attho viññāyati.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.19: saṅgho cattāro pācīnake bhikkhū cattāro pāṭheyyake bhikkhū sammannati ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.20: yassāyasmato khamati catunnaṃ pācīnakānaṃ catunnaṃ pāṭheyyakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sammati ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ sotuṇhassa
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.22: sammatā saṅghena cattāro pācīnakā bhikkhū cattāro pāṭheyyakā bhikkhū ubbāhikāya imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametuṃ.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.23: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.24: tena kho pana samayena ajito nāma bhikkhu dasavasso saṅghassa pātimokkhuddesako hoti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.28: kattha nu kho mayaṃ imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyyāmāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.30: ayaṃ kho vālikārāmo ramaṇīyo appasaddo appanigghoso
pli-tv-kd22:2.7.31: yannūna mayaṃ vālikārāme imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasameyyāmāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.3: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ sabbakāmiṃ vinayaṃ puccheyyanti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.6: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ ahaṃ revatena vinayaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeyyanti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.7: athakho āyasmā revato āyasmantaṃ sabbakāmiṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.23: kappati bhante dvaṅgulāya chāyāya vītivattāya vikāle bhojanaṃ bhuñjitunti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.35: kappati bhante idāni gāmantaraṃ gamissāmīti bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjitunti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.47: kappati bhante sambahulā āvāsā samānasīmā nānūposathaṃ kātunti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.59: kappeti bhante vaggena saṅghena kammaṃ kātuṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.73: idaṃ me upajjhāyena ajjhāciṇṇaṃ idaṃ me ācariyena ajjhāciṇṇanti
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.75: āciṇṇakappo kho āvuso ekacco kappati ekacco na kappatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.82: kappati bhante yaṃ taṃ khīraṃ khīrabhāvaṃ vijahitaṃ asampattaṃ dadhibhāvaṃ bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ pātunti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.94: kappati bhante yā sā surā asutā asampattā majjabhāvaṃ sā pātunti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.126: itipīmāni dasa vatthūni uddhammāni ubbinayāni apagatasatthusāsanānīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.127: nīhatametaṃ āvuso adhikaraṇaṃ santaṃ vūpasantaṃ suvūpasantaṃ
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.128: apica maṃ tvaṃ āvuso saṅghamajjhepi imāni dasa vatthūni puccheyyāsi tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saññattiyāti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.8.129: athakho āyasmā revato āyasmantaṃ sabbakāmiṃ saṅghamajjhepi imāni dasa vatthūni pucchi.
pli-tv-kd22:2.9.1: imāya kho pana vinayasaṅgītiyā satta bhikkhusatāni anūnāni anadhikāni ahesuṃ. tasmāyaṃ vinayasaṅgīti sattasatikāti vuccatīti.
pli-tv-kd22:2.9.2: sattasatikakkhandhakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ dvādasamaṃ. imamhi khandhake vatthū pañcavīsati.
